onboarding.welcome_body: Accurate prayer times, Qibla direction and a gentle tracker — in one calm place.
onboarding.location_body: We use your location only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla. It never leaves your phone.
onboarding.location_denied_body: Without your location, choose your city so your prayer times are right. You can allow location any time in Settings.
onboarding.location_blocked_body: Location is turned off for Hayya. Choose your city instead, or allow location in your phone’s settings.
onboarding.location_off_body: Location is switched off on your phone. Choose your city instead, or turn location on.
onboarding.location_unavailable_body: We couldn’t find your location just now. Try again, or choose your city instead.
onboarding.notifications_body: Get the call to prayer on time, plus an optional reminder before it. Change it any time.
onboarding.notifications_denied_body: No problem. You can turn on the adhan any time in Settings.
